verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an invoicing SaaS, but the evidence pack has no AI assistant, chat interface, or natural-language command feature for Zoho Invoice. The documented features are templates, payments, reminders and recurring invoices, all operated conventionally. The zoho.com llms.txt file is documentation aimed at LLMs, not a way to run the product with natural-language commands, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
